newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot, Renault six-month European sales decline.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot, Renault six-month European sales decline.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen European car sales fell 5.1 percent during the first half of this year while Renault sales fell 1.8 percent during the same period, the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association (ACEA) said on Tuesday.
Peugeot Citroen sold 761,985 units, giving it a 10.9 percent share of the market compared to 802,674 cars, or 11.7 percent of the market, for the same 1996 period.
Renault sold 659,149 cars or 9.4 percent of the market versus 670,968 cars or 9.8 percent of the market during the first six months of last year, the association said.
The overall market grew by 1.7 percent during the first half, to 6,991,700 cars from 6,876,800 for the comparable 1996 period, the association said. - Paris newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
